meta.name: seo-competitor-pages
meta.description: Generate SEO-optimized competitor comparison and alternatives pages. Covers "X vs Y" layouts, "alternatives to X" pages, feature matrices, schema markup, and conversion optimization. Use when user says "comparison page", "vs page", "alternatives page", "competitor comparison", "X vs Y", "versus", "compare competitors", or "alternative to".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成SEO优化的竞品对比与替代方案页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速创建竞品对比或替代方案页面来提升SEO和转化率。
copy.tagline_en: Generate SEO-optimized competitor comparison and alternatives pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create competitor comparison or alternatives pages to boost SEO and conversions.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能生成 SEO 优化的竞品对比和替代方案页面，包括“X vs Y”对比、替代品列表、功能矩阵、结构化数据标记和转化优化建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“对比页”、“vs 页”、“替代方案”、“竞品对比”、“X vs Y”、“versus”、“比较竞品”或“替代品”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇 Slack vs Teams 的对比页面。
say.note: 生成包含功能矩阵和推荐结论的对比页。

say.text: 生成 Notion 的替代方案页面。
say.note: 列出多个替代品并附优缺点。

say.text: 为我的产品做一个竞品功能对比表。
say.note: 输出带结构化数据的表格。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can generate SEO-optimized competitor comparison and alternatives pages, including X vs Y layouts, alternatives lists, feature matrices, schema markup, and conversion optimization suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'comparison page', 'vs page', 'alternatives page', 'competitor comparison', 'X vs Y', 'versus', 'compare competitors', or 'alternative to'.

say_en.text: Write a comparison page for Slack vs Teams.
say_en.note: Generates a page with feature matrix and verdict.

say_en.text: Create an alternatives page for Notion.
Make a competitor feature comparison table for my product.
say_en.note: Outputs a table with structured data.
